ResearchLeadAgent.why: John's saves cluster on honest condition shots, not styling alone.

AudienceResearchAgent.audience_insight: 20–32s in SG buying secondhand on a budget. They save flips where the flaw is shown first, and distrust hauls that hide condition. Constant comments asking how he cleans things.

PeerCreatorAnalysisAgent.peer_moves: Peer thrift accounts shoot polished try-ons and never show the stain or the price paid. Gap: flaw-first, price-on-screen honesty.

PlatformPresenceAgent.platform_presence: Loop Vintage curates the best rail on Haji Lane and posts stills only. No fitting-room video anywhere. John can own that slot.

PainPointAgent.pain_points: Unpredictable sourcing, stock sitting unlisted, and invented resale valuations that get creators called out in comments.

PitchEmailAgent.subject: John x Loop Vintage — 3 honest rail walks
PitchEmailAgent.body:
Hi Loop Vintage,

I'm John Tan. I flip secondhand for people in Singapore buying on a budget — I show the flaw before the fit and I put the real price on screen.

Your rail is the best curated on Haji Lane and there is no video of it anywhere. I'd like a 3-post trial filmed in store: a flaw-first pick from your rail, a fitting-room 'what I'd actually buy', and an honest what-didn't-sell follow-up. No invented resale valuations.

15 min call this week?
John
